reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction focuses on submission, omitting validation and declaration handling.

decisions.rationale: Source supports comprehensive application submission, including real-time validation and mandatory declarations.
decisions.outcome_justification: Ensures accurate, compliant AUU applications by providing real-time validation, mandatory declarations, and error handling.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately reflects collaborative completion between parents.

decisions.rationale: Source supports complete parental collaboration, including allowance distribution and payment details.
decisions.outcome_justification: Enables second parent to complete or modify application initiated by the first parent.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction omits specific documentation management and applicant notification aspects.

decisions.rationale: Source supports comprehensive INPS operator evaluation, suspension, acceptance, and applicant notification.
decisions.outcome_justification: Enables efficient and transparent application evaluation and management by INPS operators.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction focuses on application consultation, omitting allowance simulation.

decisions.rationale: Source supports comprehensive public access to application status and allowance simulation.
decisions.outcome_justification: Provides citizens with the ability to consult past applications, view general AUU information, and simulate expected monthly allowance amounts.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately reflects duplicate fiscal code prevention for children.

decisions.rationale: Source supports accurate and compliant AUU application submissions by preventing duplicate applications.
decisions.outcome_justification: Ensures data integrity and prevents duplicate applications for the same child.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction omits automatic allowance recalculation upon ISEE update.

decisions.rationale: Source supports automatic allowance adjustments based on updated economic data.
decisions.outcome_justification: Allows the system to automatically recalculate the allowance when a valid ISEE becomes available, without requiring applicant intervention.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately reflects application workflow flexibility.

decisions.rationale: Source supports flexible application workflows, including drafts and resumptions.
decisions.outcome_justification: Enables applicants to save drafts, resume applications from saved points, or discard and restart applications as needed.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction omits real-time fiscal code validation for new children.

decisions.rationale: Source supports dynamic addition of children to existing applications with real-time fiscal code validation.
decisions.outcome_justification: Enables applicants to add new children to existing applications with real-time fiscal code validation and optional modification of payment or declaration data.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately reflects GDPR-compliant data handling and privacy notices.

decisions.rationale: Source supports secure and compliant data handling and privacy notices.
decisions.outcome_justification: Ensures applicants accept GDPR-compliant privacy notices and responsibility declarations before submission, and maintains data confidentiality throughout the process.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction omits joint parent payment configuration.

decisions.rationale: Source supports multiple payment methods for allowance distribution, including joint parent payments.
decisions.outcome_justification: Enables applicants to choose from multiple payment methods including SEPA IBAN, post office domiciliation, and eligible prepaid cards, with support for joint parent payments.
